cohort: Women who had deliveries and live births in a public tertiary hospital in Klang Valley, Malaysia, between January 2010 and December 2011.
finding: Hypertensive disorders and major obstetric haemorrhage were the primary causes of maternal near-miss morbidities, with severe pre-eclampsia significantly associated with ICU utilization, indicating optimal obstetric care quality in urban Malaysia with a relatively low mortality index.
